# Preamble

```{r preamble, message=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("R", "0-config.R"))
```

# Load and prepare data

```{r load-data}
#-------------------------------
# read processed dataset
#-------------------------------
d0 <- read_rds(here("data", "ecomid_sero_vpd_2026-09-21.rds"))
length(unique(d0$sampleid))
#-------------------------------
# the source-of-information variables are child-level (constant within child).
# collapse to one row per child; denominator = children with serology (n = 370).
#-------------------------------
src_vars <- c("penta1_source", "penta2_source", "penta3_source",
              "mmr1_source", "mmr2_source")

dose_map <- c(
  penta1_source = "Penta 1", penta2_source = "Penta 2", penta3_source = "Penta 3",
  mmr1_source   = "MMR 1",   mmr2_source   = "MMR 2"
)
dose_levels <- c("Penta 1", "Penta 2", "Penta 3", "MMR 1", "MMR 2")

child <- d0 %>%
  group_by(childid) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(src_vars), ~ first(.x)), .groups = "drop")

n_children <- nrow(child)
cat("Children with serology (denominator):", n_children, "\n")

#-------------------------------
# long form: one row per child x dose; recode missing source to "No record"
#-------------------------------
src_long <- child %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(src_vars), names_to = "dose_var", values_to = "source") %>%
  mutate(
    dose   = factor(dose_map[dose_var], levels = dose_levels),
    source = factor(replace_na(source, "No record"),
                    levels = c("Vaccine card", "Maternal rep", "No record"))
  )

#-------------------------------
# counts and percentages by dose x source (denominator = all children per dose)
#-------------------------------
src_summary <- src_long %>%
  count(dose, source, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# card % with exact binomial 95% CI (denominator = n_children)
card_ci <- src_summary %>%
  filter(source == "Vaccine card") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lo = binom.test(n, n_children)$conf.int[1] * 100,
    ci_hi = binom.test(n, n_children)$conf.int[2] * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

---

# Table S2: Source of vaccination information by dose

```{r tableS2}
#-------------------------------
# wide table: rows = dose; columns = source category counts (%),
# plus vaccine-card % with exact binomial 95% CI
#-------------------------------
t10 <- src_summary %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)) %>%
  select(dose, source, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = cell) %>%
  left_join(
    card_ci %>%
      transmute(dose,
                `Vaccine card % (95% CI)` =
                  sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% to %.1f%%)", pct, ci_lo, ci_hi)),
    by = "dose"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dose) %>%
  rename(Dose = dose, `Maternal report` = `Maternal rep`)

write_csv(t10, here("output", "tables", "tableS2_vaccine_info_source.csv"))
cat("Table S2 saved.\n")

t10 %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table S2. Source of vaccination information by dose",
    subtitle = sprintf("Children with serology (n = %d)", n_children)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "n (%) by information source",
              columns = c(`Vaccine card`, `Maternal report`, `No record`)) %>%
  tab_footnote("Denominator is all children with serology (n = 370) for every dose. 'No record' = neither a vaccine card nor maternal report available for that dose. The final column repeats the vaccine-card percentage with a 95% exact binomial CI.")
```

# Figure S2: Percentage with a vaccine card record, by dose

Following the aesthetic of Figure 1B (point-and-line, dose color palette,
0–100% axis), with the pentavalent and MMR dose series connected separately.

```{r fig6, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
#-------------------------------
# shared dose palette (from 0-config.R), matching Figure 1B
#-------------------------------
dose_colors <- c(
  "Penta 1" = penta_pal[["1"]], "Penta 2" = penta_pal[["2"]], "Penta 3" = penta_pal[["3"]],
  "MMR 1"   = mmr_pal[["1"]],   "MMR 2"   = mmr_pal[["2"]]
)

fig_dat <- card_ci %>%
  mutate(vaccine = if_else(str_starts(as.character(dose), "Penta"),
                           "Pentavalent", "MMR"))

fig6 <- fig_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dose, y = pct, color = dose, group = vaccine)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray70") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = dose_colors, guide = "none") +  # doses labeled on x-axis
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Vaccine dose", y = "Children with a vaccine card record (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig6

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "figures", "figS3_vaccine_info_source.tiff"),
  plot = fig6,
  width = 150, height = 105, units = "mm", dpi = 300
)
cat("Figure S2 saved.\n")
```
